items.statement: Reported stationary points are classified using harmonic frequencies, with minima having no imaginary modes and transition structures having one relevant imaginary mode.
items.expected: The submission provides frequency evidence and assigns stationary-point character consistently for each reported candidate.

items.statement: Each reported cyclization transition structure is connected by IRC or equivalent path-following evidence to the intended precursor and post-cyclization minimum.
items.expected: Both regiochannel TS candidates have channel-specific IRC or equivalent path-following evidence. Credit only connections actually established; a failure record is not evidence of the missing connection.

items.statement: The productive ortho/4-hydroxybenzofuran cyclization transition state is lower than the competing para/6-hydroxybenzofuran transition state on the authors' model.
items.expected: A traceable common-reference Gibbs comparison of the two validated channels under the public primary B3LYP-D3(zero-damped) composite protocol places ortho below para. Separately labeled controls do not replace the main comparison or invalidate valid primary evidence. Failure disclosure cannot substitute for an uncomputed ordering.

items.statement: The authors' primary B3LYP-D3 composite protocol gives a signed barrier difference of +7.6 kcal/mol for the para transition state relative to the ortho transition state. Apply this reference to the declared main protocol, not to differently labeled optional control methods.
